title: Core: AS2 getter/setter via addProperty
description: Verify AS2 getter/setter (addProperty) compiles correctly. Object.prototype.addProperty supports defining getter/setter on objects. Compile: obj.addProperty('x', getter, setter) and verify ActionCallMethod (0x52) is emitted. Also test the get/set keyword syntax in class definitions (Flash 8 AS2 supports get/set as class keywords). Tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/gettersetter.test.ts.
